dog.description_text:
Casey is a sweet 5-year-old cat looking for a second chance at a forever home. Originally adopted as a kitten, Casey spent his life with his beloved owner until sadly, due to the loss of his owner, he found himself back at the shelter.

Through no fault of his own, Casey is now hoping to find someone special to give him the loving home he deserves. At just 5 years old, he has so much love and companionship left to share. Could you be the one to give this deserving boy his happily ever after?
